regions.today: A cloudy, wet start this morning, with outbreaks of rain, heavy in places. However, a clearance to mainly dry conditions will gradually extend from the northwest later in the morning and through the afternoon, with sunny spells following. Highest temperatures of 12 to 16 degrees. A little breezy at first this morning in eastern and southern parts, with moderate to fresh and occasionally gusty south to southwest winds, veering westerly, but light to moderate mainly westerly winds elsewhere will soon extend to all areas.
regions.tonight: Tonight will be mainly dry with clear spells and just a few well-scattered showers. Cooler than recent nights, with lowest temperatures of 3 to 8 degrees in mostly light to moderate southwest to west or variable breezes.
regions.tomorrow: Tomorrow, Friday, will bring plenty of sunshine and just well-scattered showers in the morning and afternoon, before dying away. Cooler than recently, with highest temperatures of 11 to 14 degrees and winds becoming mostly moderate northwesterly through the morning, but generally easing light to moderate again in the evening.
